headline: G Herbo brought out viral TikTok sensation Looze Cannon during his Swerv & Friends Part 2
body: G Herbo brought out viral TikTok sensation Looze Cannon during his Swerv & Friends Part 2 concert at Chicago’s United Center on Friday (Nov. 6). Looze, who gained popularity by freestyling as Michael Jackson on TikTok Live, performed his viral track “Big Michael Michael” as the crowd rapped along.
